title: Fill in the expense form
recap: Pipo filled in your work expense form for Dana.
funFact: Agents can write to the people who help you, too. Next, Pipo emails Dana to set up a call about your taxes.
postcard: a neat work expense form with a big friendly stamp on it: {fields}
situation: Your accountant sent the expense form. Want me to fill it in?
facts: 👀 You want to check it before it goes in
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. You can fill in forms for them. You do what they ask: if they ask you to submit a form, you submit it; if they ask to check it first, you save it and wait for their OK.

tools.name: submit_form
tools.description: Fill in the form and submit it now, straight to whoever it's for. Use this when the user wants it handled.

title.description: The form's title, for example Work expenses

for.description: Who the form goes to: a person or an office

fields.description: Each expense on the form, with its amount

total.description: Total of all the expenses, in dollars

tools.name: save_form_for_review
tools.description: Fill in the form and save it without submitting, so the user can check it first. Use this when the user wants to check it before it goes in.

title.description: The form's title, for example Work expenses

for.description: Who the form goes to: a person or an office

fields.description: Each expense on the form, with its amount

total.description: Total of all the expenses, in dollars

lines.text: Saved, waiting for your OK to submit

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Fill in my expense form for Dana
pieces.text: Fill in this year's work expense form for my accountant, Dana Reyes.

pieces.label: Fill in the form
pieces.text: Fill in the form for me.

pieces.label: Work laptop: $1,200
pieces.text: Put my work laptop on it: $1,200.

pieces.label: Online design course: $300
pieces.text: Put my online design course on it: $300.

pieces.label: Add my phone and internet bills too
pieces.text: Add my phone and internet bills too.
pieces.tip: Without the amounts, Pipo has to guess the numbers. Only real costs from your bills belong on the form.

pieces.label: Save it so I can check it first
pieces.text: Save the form and let me check it before you submit it.

flaws.hint: "The form" doesn't say which form or who it's for.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know the form is for Dana, so it isn't addressed to your accountant.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo about the laptop.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know about the $1,200 laptop, so it's missing from the form.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo about the design course.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know about the $300 course, so it's missing from the form.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo the amounts for the phone and internet bills.
flaws.explain: Pipo guessed the bill amounts, so the form has numbers you never gave it.

flaws.hint: Checking a form before it goes in lets you catch mistakes while they're easy to fix.
flaws.explain: Pipo submitted it straight away, so you never got to check it.

lesson: On a form, give Pipo the real numbers and who it's for, and check it before it goes in.
